dateOptions.formulaQuery:
CASE
    WHEN DATEPART('day', x) <= 7 THEN 1
    WHEN DATEPART('day', x) <= 14 THEN 2
    WHEN DATEPART('day', x) <= 21 THEN 3
    WHEN DATEPART('day', x) <= 28 THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END
dateOptions.name: Week of Month
